summary: Practise T-SQL queries, Python scripting, pandas analysis, and SQL Server connections. Explore the 10-day foundation course.
lede: Transact-SQL and Python training helps data analysts, reporting specialists, and operational staff query and prepare structured data in SQL Server. You practise filtering and joining records, building summaries with T-SQL and pandas, and writing basic Python scripts that connect to SQL Server. Exercises also cover transaction-aware data changes, CSV validation, and repeatable reporting workflows with checks for incomplete or inconsistent results.
audienceIntro: This foundation course is for professionals who query, prepare, check, or report structured data in SQL Server and want to add Python to their workflow.
prerequisites: Basic computer use and familiarity with files and folders are expected. No prior programming experience is required. You should be ready to practise basic SQL Server queries and beginner Python code.
